answer: Splitting into 9 separate vaults demands a separate funded trellis account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The mesa explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
